title: main.tscn + main.gd are orphaned placeholder scaffold, superseded by run.tscn as the boot scene
evidence:
project.godot:15  run/main_scene="res://scenes/run.tscn"
main.tscn:2  [ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://c2mgf0cu6b8nk" path="res://scripts/main.gd" id="1_main"]
main.tscn:6  [node name="Main" type="Control" unique_id=1414506580]
main.tscn:18  text = "Packet Plumber\n— prototype coming —"
main.gd:1  extends Control  ## Placeholder root for the Packet Plumber project.
(grep for 'main.tscn' across game/ returns no references; nothing loads it. main.gd is referenced only by main.tscn.)
detail: The placeholder scene/script predate the prototype. run.tscn is the real boot scene, so main.tscn + main.gd are dead — never loaded, no functional role (the window title already comes from project.godot config/name).
recommended_fix: Delete game/scenes/main.tscn and game/scripts/main.gd (and their .uid files). run.tscn is the boot scene; the placeholder is no longer needed.
